description:
Description

The Messaging Engineer will provide second and third line support for Exchange Hybrid (Online and On-prem), Archiving (EV), and Email Security and Protection across all Baker McKenzie offices. The role‑holder will provide support, design, and apply best practices, developing standards and policies for the Messaging systems. The individual will analyze and resolve issues, and deliver new technology capabilities related to the Messaging environment.

The Messaging Engineer will also contribute to the delivery of Global IT Messaging projects to all Firm offices and focus on the Global Messaging environment, delivering Messaging support, solutions and deliverables to the Globe.

Main Responsibilities
  • Participate in regular conference calls and meetings with the Global Messaging Team and provide updates or concerns raised at the local office level
  • Provide input into current and new Global Messaging policies and standards related to Exchange, EV, and security
  • Provide guidance to local offices on consolidation efforts
  • Assist with training and mentoring team members to raise the technical skill level of the entire team
  • Ensure that all support incidents are reported and tracked in the ServiceNow system; work through each ticket to resolution or escalate/re-assign as necessary per agreed SLAs, ensuring that the local office IT staff and requestor are updated on the status of their incidents at all times
  • Liaise with colleagues in Global teams, vendors, and third parties to resolve incidents
  • Participate in Global technical teams to develop recommendations for standards and policies for IT systems used within the Firm
  • Attend conferences and seminars to retain awareness of current IT technologies applicable to the Firm and make recommendations as appropriate
  • Retain skills relevant to the position on an ongoing basis through training (instructor-led and CBT as appropriate), and periodic review of technical journals, white papers, and manuals
  • Provide training to local office IT staff for key systems supported, through one-on-one or group training sessions
  • Provide 24/7 on-call support to offices on a rota basis with other Messaging team members
  • Maintain relevant systems at the Global level, ensuring all applicable change-control procedures are followed
  • Deliver Global IT projects to offices; the degree of involvement will vary from overall project management to performing individual tasks, including upgrades to existing systems, migrations to alternative systems, and installation of new technologies
  • Create and maintain documentation for policies and procedures
  • Manage high-volume, professional email correspondence, ensuring prompt, accurate, and friendly responses
  • Resolve requestor issues by researching problems, providing solutions, and troubleshooting product/service inquiries and issues
  • Support and maintain the Global Messaging infrastructure, including security, standards, and policy enforcement
  • Provide after hours support via phone and computer
  • Responsible for keeping incidents within Service Level Agreement timelines
  • Responsible for keeping the team/end users informed as to status of incidents and escalating as appropriate when additional assistance is required to resolve
  • Responsible for reporting time spent on activities
Skills And Experience
  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is preferred
  • Experience in supporting enterprise‑level Messaging environments
  • Proficient in designing and supporting the following technologies:
    • Microsoft Exchange Hybrid (Online and SE)
    • Rubrik M365 backup systems for Exchange recovery
    • Veritas Enterprise Vault (server and client)
    • Messaging Security tools, including Proofpoint, Microsoft Defender, and Abnormal
    • Purview e‑discovery tasks
    • PowerShell scripting: Proficient in automation, administration, and troubleshooting
    • Protocols: In-depth understanding of email protocols and technologies (SMTP, DNS, MX Records, TLS, DMARC, SPF, DKIM).
  • Able to work independently without direct supervision
  • Effective written and spoken communication skills
  • Must be a team player
  • Must demonstrate initiative
  • Must have an interest in learning new and evolving Messaging technologies
  • Willing to travel domestically and internationally when requested
  • Able to provide after hours and weekend support via phone and computer when required
Travel Requirements

Some travel may be required.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Customer Risk Management Director

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

Overview

We are currently looking for a Director, reporting to the VP of Customer Risk Management (CRM) for the Americas. The role is based in São Paulo, Brazil and will have an initial focus on Brazil.

Mastercard has close to $90B credit exposure to its customers and other counterparties worldwide, placing the CRM role as a key part of its evolving and quickly growing business model. The CRM team operates as a vital component of the broader Strategy & Operations organization, playing a critical role in supporting and driving Mastercard’s success. The magnitude and strategic nature of this exposure necessitates engagement with senior management, Mastercard’s sales and product organizations as well as our customers. This further provides great opportunities to grow your career within Mastercard.

This role is on the first line of defense, with key responsibilities including CRM strategy and roadmap for the assigned portfolio, customer credit analysis and underwriting, formulating risk mitigation approach, developing risk management solutions for new products, and engaging regulators within the region.

Responsibilities
  • Owning all CRM related matters for the assigned portfolio and directing the small team of Managers/Analysts in some of the required actions with appropriate prioritization
  • Performing and/or reviewing customer credit risk underwriting analysis, formulating recommendations, and presenting the same to senior management for approval
  • Leading the development and negotiations of risk militants for customers with the account managers and customers
  • Understanding and partnering to design innovative approaches to cater to customers with different business models
  • Developing new risk management solutions for new products, e.g., crypto
  • Leading complex cross-functional CRM initiatives

description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

CLT, São Paulo Hybrid

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro , com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software , atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência .

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica , a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.

Requirements

A área de Segurança da Informação é responsável por garantir a observância de controles técnicos de segurança robustos, oferecendo suporte às áreas de negócio e contribuindo para a contínua redução de riscos organizacionais. Buscamos um Gerente de Application Security (AppSec) | DevSecOps & Segurança Ofensiva para compor nosso time na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução.

O Gerente será responsável por liderar a estratégia, implementação e governança de Application Security, além de supervisionar iniciativas de Threat Emulation, teste de segurança ofensiva, hardening de aplicações e conformidade com padrões seguros de engenharia. Atuará de forma estratégica e hands‑on junto às equipes de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e produto, garantindo que aplicações e APIs sejam construídas de forma resiliente, segura e alinhada às melhores práticas do mercado financeiro.

Esse Cargo Será Responsável Por
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter o Programa Corporativo de Desenvolvimento Seguro (SDL/SSDLC), garantindo segurança desde a concepção até a operação dos produtos.
  • Definir e evoluir padrões de Application Security, incluindo revisão de código seguro, guidelines, controles, bibliotecas e frameworks.
  • Liderar iniciativas de Threat Emulation, Threat Modeling (STRIDE, DREAD, MITRE ATT&CK) e simulações ofensivas orientadas a riscos.
  • Implementar pipeline de segurança em CI/CD com ferramentas como SAST, SCA, DAST e análise de containers.
  • Avaliar, orientar e acompanhar correções de vulnerabilidades identificadas em aplicações, APIs, microserviços e integrações.
  • Conduzir revisões arquiteturais, apoiando equipes de engenharia na definição de padrões seguros. Trabalhar com o modelo Zero Trust, garantindo que aplicações e APIs sigam princípios de autenticação e autorização fortes.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir mecanismos de segurança em APIs, microsserviços e aplicações distribuídas.
  • Construir fluxos de automação e governança em ferramentas de tickets para solicitações, auditorias e demandas de AppSec.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de engenharia para identificação, mitigação e prevenção de riscos em código e arquitetura.
  • Realizar e supervisionar testes ofensivos internos (Threat Emulation), como pentests direcionados, exploração de APIs e simulações de ataques.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento e SRE na aplicação de patches, correções e mitigação de vulnerabilidades.
  • Garantir conformidade com padrões regulatórios do mercado financeiro, incluindo normas do Banco Central, NIST, ISO 27001, OWASP e requisitos de auditoria.
  • Gerenciar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, elevar o nível de maturidade em AppSec e atuar como referência técnica interna.
Para dar #match, essa vaga necessita que atenda alguns requisitos obrigatórios
  • Atuação consolidada em Application Security (AppSec), com liderança de iniciativas estratégicas e técnicas.
  • Vivência prática com SDL/SSDLC e integração de segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Conhecimento sólido em segurança ofensiva aplicada a aplicações, incluindo análise de vulnerabilidades, revisão segura de código, APIs e Threat Modeling.
  • Experiência com práticas e ferramentas de DevSecOps, como SAST, SCA, DAST e análise de containers, com foco em automação.
  • Boa compreensão de padrões e frameworks de segurança (OWASP, NIST, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
  • Capacidade de análise arquitetural com orientação a decisões técnicas seguras para aplicações e APIs.
  • Vivência em gerir times multidisciplinares.
  • Formação Superior.
  • Inglês avançado.
Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial
  • Experiência em implantação de SDL/SSDLC e segurança em ambientes DevOps/DevSecOps. SAST, SCA, DAST, IAST, container scanning e hardening de aplicações.
  • Acompanhamento e priorização de vulnerabilidades (CVSS, CWE, OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10).
  • Requisitos de segurança para APIs e microsserviços.
  • Revisões de código seguro e análise de arquitetura.
  • Experiência com Threat Modeling, simulações MITRE ATT&CK e testes de segurança direcionados.
  • Execução ou supervisão de pentests internos.
  • Análise de exploração, vetores de ataque, falhas logicas e segurança de APIs.
  • Experiência avançada com Zero Trust aplicado a aplicações.
  • Experiência com integração de AppSec no pipeline DevOps (Azure DevOps, GitLab, GitHub).
  • Ferramentas de orquestração, APIs, scripts (PowerShell, Python).
Benefits

E ai, se identificou com o que leu até agora? Então, vou te contar o que você encontrará aqui, além de um ambiente dinâmico:

  • Vale refeição ou alimentação;

Descrição da vaga

O que somos

A Galapagos Capital é uma companhia de investimentos global , com soluções financeiras interconectadas para você, sua família e seu negócio.

Investment Banking onde criamos soluções de crédito e M&A de forma flexível, simples e eficiente, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes. É fácil fazer negócio com a gente!

Asset Management onde nosso time de analistas seniores realiza análises contínuas e minuciosas do mercado adaptadas ao cenário econômico global, que norteiam as estratégias de investimentos para soluções financeiras mais assertivas aos portfólios dos nossos clientes. Aliando performance com resiliência!

Wealth Management , onde promovemos o acesso mais transparente e eficiente ao mercado de capitais, aprimorando a forma de fazer banking, através da criação de produtos exclusivos e da expertise de profissionais com mais de 30 anos de mercado em gestão de patrimônio e riscos. Evoluímos o seu jeito de investir!

Nossa missão

Acreditamos no poder transformador do mercado financeiro que une, de forma eficiente, quem precisa de crédito e quem tem capital para investir. Num mercado bastante concentrado e dominado por grandes bancos, como o brasileiro, o potencial para essa transformação é imenso. A Galapagos Capital quer liderar esse processo. Adotamos um jeito disruptivo de fazer banking: sem agências e sem a utilização de balanço.

Por ser inovadora, leve e criativa , a Galapagos reúne a capacidade de originar, estruturar e alocar operações de crédito de maneira que nossos clientes possam usufruir desses rendimentos de forma rentável e com pouca volatilidade. Desse jeito, ajudamos empresas e pessoas a terem acesso a crédito de forma competitiva e transformamos esses créditos em soluções de investimento - tudo dentro de casa.

A evolução na forma de fazer Banking - Somos mais eficientes, mais ágeis e, principalmente, oferecemos resultados muito melhores para nossos clientes. É para isso que a Galapagos nasceu: para ajudar o mercado financeiro a evoluir, alcançando seu potencial e beneficiando milhões de brasileiros.

Saiba mais sobre a Galapagos:

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Missão do cargo:

Será responsável pela gestão de portfólio da carteira de obras de reforços e melhorias de pequeno porte da AXIA - Sudeste.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  • Apoio na abertura e estruturação de projetos, organizando informações técnicas e financeiras, assegurando alinhamento entre escopo, cronograma e orçamento.
  • Gestão de CAPEX, incluindo planejamento, acompanhamento físico-financeiro e análise de desvios.
  • Acompanhar e gerir os indicadores e metas financeiras das gerências da Operação da AXIA Sudeste.

  • Apoiar na gestão técnica contratual dos empreendimentos de transmissão, envolvendo as consolidações de medições mensais de serviços, análises de pleitos e aditivos até o encerramento contratual.
  • Apoiar no controles físicos-financeiros de projetos de implantação, reforço ou modernização de:
    • Subestações de energia elétrica;
    • Linhas de Transmissão.
  • Interagir com áreas internas, promovendo integração entre informações técnicas, operacionais e financeiras.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, painéis de acompanhamento e apresentações para apoio à gerência em reuniões com Alta Governança.

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia elétrica, civil, mecânico ou de produção;
  • Experiência nos processos de :
    • Abertura, estruturação e acompanhamento de EAP;
    • Gestão e acompanhamento de CAPEX;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre empreendimentos de transmissão de energia (subestações e linhas de transmissão);
  • Conhecimento dos processos de gestão contratual, desde as fases que antecedem, até o encerramento;
  • Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico - MCPSE da ANEEL;
  • Conhecimento dos processos corporativos de planejamento e orçamento;
  • Conhecimento prático dos pacotes SAP de gestão de projetos, controle orçamentário, e gestão financeira;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio à gestão, incluindo:
    • Excel em nível avançado;
    • Disponibilidade para residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ , São Paulo/SP ou Brasília/DF.
Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento do cadastramento, atualização e baixas de obras no sistema Sintegra do ONS;
  • Desejável Certificações: PMP (Project Management Professional) do PMI (Project Management Institute) ou IPMA (International Project Management Association);

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. title: Coordenador de Garantia da Qualidade
description:
Responsável por supervisionar e coordenar todas as atividades relacionadas à garantia de qualidade em uma organização. Sua principal função é garantir que os produtos ou serviços da empresa atendam aos requisitos de qualidade estabelecidos, bem como às normas e regulamentos aplicáveis.

Principais Atribuições
  • Desenvolvimento e implementação de processos: O coordenador de garantia de qualidade é responsável por desenvolver e implementar processos e procedimentos para garantir a qualidade dos produtos ou serviços da empresa. Isso inclui a definição de padrões de qualidade, a criação de planos de inspeção e testes e a definição de indicadores-chaves de desempenho (KPIs) para avaliar a qualidade.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento: É responsabilidade do coordenador as atividades de treinamento em relação aos requisitos de qualidade e aos procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso pode incluir a organização de programas de treinamento, workshops e atividades de desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Análise de dados e relatórios: O coordenador deve analisar dados de qualidade e preparar relatórios para a alta administração. Isso inclui a identificação de tendências, a identificação de áreas problemáticas e a recomendação de ações corretivas ou preventivas para melhorar a qualidade.
  • Colaboração com outras áreas: O coordenador de garantia de qualidade deve colaborar com outros departamentos, como produção, pesquisa e desenvolvimento, compras, validação, controle de qualidade, calibração, atendimento ao cliente e outras áreas pertinentes. Isso é importante para garantir a qualidade em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do produto ou serviço.
  • Conformidade regulatória: O coordenador deve acompanhar e garantir a conformidade com as normas e regulamentos aplicáveis à indústria em que a empresa opera. Isso pode envolver a manutenção de registros adequados, a realização de auditorias externas, a consolidação das auditorias internas e, quando necessário, a comunicação com as autoridades regulatórias ou normativas.
Requisitos
  • Nível superior completo em Química, Engenharia, Farmácia ou cursos relacionados.

  • Ensure disciplined governance across the full lifecycle: discovery, development, rollout, and optimization.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, Operations, and Customer Services to align innovation initiatives with business priorities.
  • Influence decision-making through data-driven insights, business cases, and performance reviews.
Performance, Scale & Value Creation
  • Own regional performance management, tracking adoption, financial impact, and scalability of programs.
  • Ensure that innovation initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes, not just pilots or experiments.
  • Drive a culture of learning, iteration, and scale, leveraging insights from execution to improve platforms.
Talent & Career Development

Day-to-Day Activities
  • Set regional priorities and approve program roadmaps.
  • Lead portfolio and governance reviews.
  • Coach and align Program Managers and Regional Managers.

  • External: Strategic partners, vendors, selected customers, innovation ecosystem partners (as needed).
What Success Looks Like
  • Business Innovation operates as a scalable regional platform, not isolated country initiatives.
  • Programs launch with speed, discipline, and clear standards.
  • Strong and consistent adoption across all LATAM markets.
  • Clear linkage between innovation initiatives and revenue, margin, or efficiency impact.

Required Experience & Skills

About This Role

The Tax Manager, LATAM will own Udemy’s Brazilian tax compliance and planning for our limited‑risk distribution entity and play a key role in supporting scalable tax operations across Latin America. This role combines hands‑on operational tax management, advisory collaboration, and proactive support for Udemy’s continued growth across Latin America.

The ideal candidate is someone who thrives at the intersection of compliance, business partnership, and strategic advisory — able to translate complex tax rules into scalable, business‑ready processes.

What you’ll be doing
  • Manage all direct and indirect tax compliance for Udemy’s Brazil legal entity, including corporate income tax (IRPJ/CSLL), PIS/COFINS, ISS, ICMS, and transfer pricing filings.
  • Oversee the limited‑risk distributor (LRD) structure, including cost‑plus model, intercompany agreements, and tax‑effected profitability analysis in coordination with HQ.
  • Partner with external advisors and local accounting providers to ensure timely filings, reconciliations, and audits.
  • Provide guidance and coordinate tax compliance for Udemy’s current and future operations across LATAM — including evaluating local withholding, VAT, and tax registration requirements.
  • Support regional tax risk assessments and process improvements in collaboration with local finance and legal partners.
  • Assist with cross‑border tax audits, treaty interpretation, and transfer pricing documentation in the region.
  • Contribute to global tax initiatives such as DAC7, digital services tax (DST), and BEPS Pillar 2 readiness.
What you’ll have
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Law, or Economics.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in Brazilian corporate taxation.
  • Strong command of direct and indirect taxes (IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS, ICMS).
  • Experience with limited‑risk distributor or cost‑plus structures and intercompany arrangements.
  • Experience working with ERP and tax engines.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work across cultural and functional boundaries.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a track record of process improvement and innovation in tax operations.
Why work here?

Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

Um futuro mais saudável. Isso é o que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso aos cuidados de saúde de que precisam hoje e para as gerações futuras. A healthier future drives us to innovate. description:
A Brokers Brasil é uma empresa de educação especializada no mercado imobiliário. Ajudamos corretores, imobiliárias, incorporadoras e construtoras a se posicionarem no digital, gerarem oportunidades pela internet e estruturarem processos comerciais para vender mais.

Em menos de um ano de empresa, nossa metodologia já impactou mais de 200 profissionais e gerou mais de 1,5 bilhão de reais em vendas para parceiros e clientes.

Somos uma empresa em crescimento acelerado e com cultura de alta performance. Aqui, resultado é reconhecido, evolução é incentivada e quem performa cresce junto com a empresa.

MISSÃO

Gerar oportunidades comerciais por meio de conversas estratégicas nas redes sociais da Brokers Brasil, principalmente no Instagram. O Social Seller interage com pessoas que demonstraram interesse nos conteúdos da empresa, seja ao seguir o perfil, enviar mensagens ou interagir nas publicações. A partir dessas interações, conduz conversas para entender o perfil do potencial cliente, identificar seu momento de compra e coletar seus dados de contato. Quando identifica uma oportunidade qualificada, direciona o lead para uma reunião com o time de vendas.

FUNÇÕES
  • Iniciar conversas estratégicas com potenciais clientes nas redes sociais
  • Abordar, conduzir e responder conversas com leads interessados nos conteúdos da empresa
  • Qualificar potenciais clientes por meio de análise e perguntas estratégicas
  • Identificar dores, momento e potencial de compra do lead
  • Direcionar leads qualificados para reuniões com o time de vendas
  • Realizar follow up de conversas e manter relacionamento com potenciais clientes
  • Registrar interações e oportunidades no CRM
  • Coletar contatos do WhatsApp através do Instagram
REQUISITOS
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Escuta ativa e capacidade de conduzir conversas estratégicas
  • Energia e entusiasmo no contato com potenciais clientes
  • Resiliência diante de objeções e rejeições
  • Organização e disciplina para executar rotina comercial
  • Disposição para aprender, aplicar feedbacks e evoluir constantemente
DIFERENCIAIS
  • Experiência prévia com área de pré vendas
  • Experiência gerando oportunidades através de Instagram, WhatsApp ou LinkedIn
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas como SPIN Selling
  • Experiência com venda de serviços ou produtos de alto valor
  • Experiência com o mercado imobiliário
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na região da Berrini em São Paulo
CULTURA DE PERFORMANCE

Esta é uma posição comercial com metas claras de geração de oportunidades e reuniões qualificadas. Buscamos pessoas que gostem de desafios, tenham mentalidade de resultado e se sintam motivadas por metas e crescimento profissional.

A posição de Social Seller faz parte da estrutura comercial da Brokers Brasil. Profissionais de alta performance podem evoluir para posições como Closer, Executivo de Vendas ou outras áreas da empresa.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
  • Vaga PJ
  • Remuneração fixa por performance entre 2.500 e 3.200 reais
  • Comissionamento de 0,4% sobre vendas com ticket médio de 30 mil reais

About the Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia‑Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra‑city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit:

About the Team / Role

We are seeking a Senior Compliance Officer to serve as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to our commercial operations in Brazil. Your mission is to integrate compliance seamlessly into business strategy and daily operations, enabling sustainable growth. You will be embedded within business units, working closely with Sales, Products, Operations, Marketing and HR leadership to provide pragmatic guidance on complex commercial practices, regulatory challenges and employee relations.

In this role, you’ll be…
  • Act as the primary, dedicated compliance advisor to assigned business units, proactively participating in business meetings and strategic initiatives to provide forward‑looking, risk‑based solutions.
  • Offer clear, actionable counsel on complex compliance matters involving third‑party management, gifts & hospitality, conflicts of interest, anti‑corruption, anti‑fraud, etc. in day‑to‑day operations.
  • Lead compliance risk assessments for new business initiatives, market campaigns, and partnerships, designing effective and business‑practical mitigation controls.
  • Monitor the regulatory landscape and ensure the company’s practices remain compliant with new laws, translating regulatory requirements and internal policies into clear business language and processes.
  • Develop and deliver engaging, scenario‑based compliance training tailored to specific business functions, empowering line managers and employees.
  • Champion a culture of integrity and ethical decision‑making through daily interactions and advisory support.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for compliance concerns arising within the business, identifying any potential misconduct, fraud, corruption and violations of the Code of Conduct.
  • Lead and conduct confidential internal investigations into allegations of misconduct, fraud, corruption, and violations of the Code of Conduct, preparing clear, concise, and well‑documented investigation reports for senior management.
We’re eager to be in touch because you have…
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law or a related field. A post‑graduate degree is a plus.
  • Demonstrable expertise in three key areas: Brazilian Labor Law, internal investigations, and compliance program management.
  • 10+ years of proven experience in compliance, internal audit, or a related field, with a significant portion dedicated to conducting internal investigations.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to provide pragmatic, risk‑based advice to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven leadership skills and the ability to operate independently in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Excellent project management and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Exceptional interviewing, analytical, and report‑writing skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.
You’ll love working at DiDi because…

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone’s best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD). The company’s diversity initiatives are guided by the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups.

title: Groepsbegeleider Jeugdzorg – flexpool/invalkracht regio Midden Nederland
description:
Wil je werken wanneer het jou uitkomt? Timon biedt mogelijkheden voor enthousiaste zorgprofessionals. Lees hierover meer over onze actuele vacature groepsbegeleider jeugdzorg – flexpool/invalkracht midden Nederland. Wil je meer weten over de functie van groepsbegeleider bekijk dan onze video.

Je werkt wanneer jij wilt. Dit kan de ene week 8 uur zijn en de volgende week 24 of een week niet, net wat jou uitkomt. Je kunt zelf aangeven welke diensten je wilt werken en op welke locatie. Er dag-, avond- en nachtdiensten.

Daadkrachtig, empathisch en hoopvol

Soms kan een jongere niet meer thuis wonen. Is zelfstandig wonen een brug te ver, vanwege complexe problematiek? Dan biedt Timon een veilige woonplek in een 24-uurs voorziening. Hier werken jongeren aan herstel en aan hun toekomst. Als groepsbegeleider begeleid je hen in het dagelijkse leven. Ze kunnen op jou rekenen. Je geeft hen een goede basis, structuur en handvatten om hun leven op de rit te krijgen. Dat vraagt om daadkracht, empathie en vasthoudendheid. Je bent sociaal vaardig en hebt een sterke persoonlijkheid. Want je maakt nogal eens wat mee.

Jouw werk doet ertoe!

Als groepsbegeleider ben je er voor de jongeren. Je zorgt voor huiselijkheid. En helpt en stimuleert hen bij wat ze lastig vinden: van huiswerk en koken tot vriendschappen. Als groepsbegeleider leef je het normale leven voor aan de jongeren. Houd er rekening mee dat je ook administratieve taken hebt. Je voert de dagelijkse doelen uit en ziet erop toe dat ze gebeuren. Het doel van jouw werk? Dat de jongere veiligheid en nabijheid ervaart en zich van daaruit ontwikkelt. Kortom, jouw werk doet ertoe!

“Je hebt veel vrijheid om je diensten in te vullen. In het contact met de jongeren signaleer je wat een jongere nodig heeft en stem je af wat nodig is” Linda van Oorschot, groepsbegeleider

Dit vragen we van je
  • Minimaal een Mbo-diploma niveau 4, bijvoorbeeld SPW. Of volg je een sociale studie op HBO/WO niveau.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met groepswerk en/of mensenwerk.
  • Kennis van en inzicht in groepsdynamische processen.
  • Flexibele inzetbaarheid (onregelmatige diensten, ook slaapdiensten).
Dit bieden wij
  • Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op:
  • Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 7) vanaf € 2.818,26 tot € 4.027,70 afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
  • Een flexibel contract voor een jaar
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld, onregelmatigheidstoeslag en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Binnen Timon krijg je een inwerktraject waarin je op elke voorziening een dienst gaat meedraaien, zodat je op elke voorziening een keer geweest bent. Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie zoals: Competentiegericht werken & Verbindend Gezag, Open & Alert en Motiverende gespreksvoering & Oplossingsgericht werken.
  • Deze functie noemen we in ons functiehuis Jeugdzorgwerker D.
Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jou. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Jij @ Timon?

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij jou past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor groepsbegeleider. Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met teammanager Jan Willem ten Brinke, via of met onze recruiter Johan van den Brink als je vragen hebt over de procedure, via .

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

Powerful search, reasoning, and action

Once connected to all your tools and apps, Computer is embedded in your full business context. It can find and summarize, sure. Even more impressive: it offers employees insights, strategic and proactive suggestions, plus powerful agentic actions.

Extensions for your teams and customers

Computer doesn’t make you choose between new software and old. Its AI-native platform lets you extend existing tools with sophisticated apps and agents. So your teams – and your customers – can take action, seamlessly. These agents work alongside you: updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and syncing back to your systems.

This isn’t just software. Computer brings people back together, breaking down silos and ushering in the future of teamwork, through human-AI collaboration. Stop managing software. Stop wasting time. Start solving bigger problems, building better products, and making your customers happier.

We call this Team Intelligence. It’s why DevRev exists.

Trusted by global companies across multiple industries, DevRev is backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield, with $150M+ raised. We are 650+ people, across eight global offices.

About The Role

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer with hands‑on experience designing, building, and maintaining web applications, web services, and APIs. In this role, you will own the full development lifecycle of an internal incident management platform — from architecture and implementation through to deployment and ongoing maintenance. You will work closely with cross‑functional teams including engineering, product, and operations to deliver a robust, scalable, and secure application. You should bring a strong foundation in software development best practices, distributed systems, observability, and modern AI‑assisted development workflows.

What You'll Do
  • Design, develop, and maintain the incident management platform, including a TypeScript-based frontend and Go-based backend services and APIs.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, and post‑release maintenance.
  • Build and maintain RESTful and/or event‑driven APIs, ensuring reliability, performance, and clear API contracts.
  • Instrument the application with observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing) to ensure full visibility into system health and behavior in production.
  • Investigate and resolve bugs and performance issues using native logs, distributed tracing tools such as Datadog, and internal tooling.
  • Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle, including input validation, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Contribute to sprint planning, technical prioritization, and stakeholder updates, helping the team deliver iteratively and predictably.
  • Write clear technical documentation, architectural decision records, and runbooks to scale team knowledge and reduce operational overhead.
  • Advocate for continuous improvement of platform reliability, developer experience, and engineering processes based on operational insights and team feedback.
  • Highlight technical risks, system limitations, and dependencies early, ensuring all prerequisites are addressed before new development cycles begin.

description:
This is not a teaching position. It is an academic operations role for a US K-12 School.

English required. Portuguese not required.

Role Overview
  • Qualification: Mid-level (3+ years in academic operations or school management)
  • Contract: Contractor (PJ) - full-time
  • Compensation: Competitive fixed monthly amount + variable bonus, aligned with experience
  • Location: Hybrid, 3+ days on-site in Sao Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel.
About Us

WorldEd is an established K‑12 school and education provider with an international footprint built through long‑term partnerships with schools and educational institutions. We support partners with high‑quality learning solutions and a delivery model designed for real implementation. As we grow, we are strengthening our academic operations team with people who execute reliably, ensuring instructional excellence and operational consistency across every classroom.

Job Overview

In this role, you will own WorldEd's academic operating system, ensuring our pedagogical model, standards, and daily operations are consistently executed across classrooms, schedules, and systems. As the Principal's right hand, you will safeguard instructional quality through observation and feedback, translate strategy into clear routines and metrics, and ensure the school runs smoothly while improving over time. You will also support coordination with external accreditation bodies and American education organizations, including the US State Department of Education, Cognia, The College Board, and NCAA.

Availability & Travel Expectations (important)

This role includes on‑site presence (3+ days per week in São Paulo) with some flexibility during key moments in the academic calendar. From time to time, you may participate in evening or weekend activities such as school events. There may also be occasional opportunities for travel to partner schools or professional development events.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own and manage the academic operating system: calendars, schedules, substitutions, and coverage plans ensuring continuity and disciplined execution.
  • Monitor attendance, engagement, grading flow, and service levels; proactively identify and resolve operational blockers.
  • Ensure consistent execution of WorldEd's pedagogical model through regular classroom observations with structured rubrics and actionable feedback.
  • Lead professional development sessions aligned with instructional improvement priorities.
  • Track academic and operational KPIs, run regular performance reviews, and translate insights into action plans.
  • Coordinate Teachers, Tutors, and Registrar, reinforcing academic rigor, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Act on behalf of the Principal during absences, ensuring stability and informed decision‑making.
  • Support compliance with accreditation requirements (Cognia, College Board, NCAA, US State Department) through documentation, trackers, and reports.
Qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience in academic operations within an American or international school context, with exposure to US accreditation standards and American curriculum frameworks.
  • Proven ability to run academic operations: scheduling, routines, execution discipline, and follow‑through.
  • Strong instructional judgment, including experience observing classes and providing actionable feedback.
  • High data literacy: ability to interpret academic and operational metrics and drive decisions through evidence.
  • Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams in a hands‑on, execution‑focused environment.
  • Excellent communication skills for meetings, documentation, and sensitive stakeholder conversations.
  • Strong organizational skills, reliability under pressure, and comfort handling multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting accreditation readiness, audits, or compliance documentation.
  • Working knowledge of continuous improvement practices (PDCA, root‑cause analysis).
  • Experience in cross‑cultural or international education environments.
  • Exposure to multi‑campus, multi‑program, or international school networks.
This Role Is Not for You If…
  • ... you avoid accountability for outcomes and prefer to stay in an advisory or opinion‑only capacity.
  • ... you struggle with the pace and ambiguity of a small organization where roles extend beyond a narrow job description.
  • ... you prefer to "hand off" problems instead of owning them through to resolution.
  • ... you do only what is explicitly assigned and avoid going the extra mile when needed.
What We Offer
  • Full scholarship for direct dependents in WorldEd's American programs.
  • Total Pass wellness and quality of life benefit.
  • Hybrid work model: 3+ days on‑site in Sao Paulo (Zona Sul); availability for nationwide travel (evenings/weekends as needed).
  • Competitive fixed monthly amount + bonus, aligned with experience.

If you're passionate about academic excellence, have a talent for turning strategy into disciplined daily execution, and excel at coordinating teams with clarity and accountability, we want to hear from you!

description:
Job Description Why This Role? Why Now?

Customer experience is transforming through AI‑driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change – we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionizing how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology.

Mission

As an AI Services Consultant, your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure seamless integration and optimization of AI solutions, driving transformative business outcomes.

Overarching Objective For The Role
  • Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realize measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale.
  • Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
  • Lead smooth, on‑time delivery. Run projects end‑to‑end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
How You’ll Make an Impact Strategic Accountabilities
  • Technical Expertise & Guidance: Provide expert advice on the implementation and optimization of Zendesk AI products, ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
  • Change Management & Training: Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and integration of AI solutions within customer organizations.
  • Successful Project Delivery: Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
  • Tactical solutions for business outcomes: Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.
What You’ll Need to Succeed Strategic Skills & Expertise
  • Consulting Expertise: Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Project Management: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
  • Technical Proficiency in AI: Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimize these solutions effectively.
  • Agility and Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
  • Problem‑Solving Abilities: Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
  • Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting‑edge solutions to clients.
Qualifications
  • Must have a minimum of 5+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services.
  • For SP7 – Principal: Must have a minimum of 7+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services.
  • Previous experience in go‑to‑customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS – either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre‑sales consulting.
  • Experience in using adoption and health analytics to build predictive models and forecasts for churn and expansion; surface early risk signals and recommended mitigations to secure retention and growth.
  • Experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
  • Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
  • Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
  • Excellent program management and cross‑functional influence skills.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus.
  • Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders.
Hybrid

In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration – while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in‑office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working enables us to purposefully come together in person at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn while also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

title: Process Engineer, Senior
description:
Ausenco is a fast-growing company with big ideas. We redefine what’s possible in some of the world’s most complex projects and toughest environments. Delivering innovative, value-add consulting, project delivery, asset operations and maintenance solutions is what we do. From 21 offices in 9 countries, with projects in over 80 locations worldwide, we create sustainable outcomes for our people, clients and communities.

Our team in Brazilis growing, we are currently recruiting for a Process Engineer, Senior to join our Minerals & Metals Business line in the in Belo Horizonte - MG office.

About the role
  • The engineer will be responsible for leading projects within the Mineral Processing department, ensuring the quality, consistency, and robustness of engineering information and solutions;
  • Key responsibilities include the sizing and selection of process equipment, the definition, analysis, and optimization of mineral processing routes, as well as the interpretation of laboratory, pilot, and industrial test results;
  • In addition to serving as a technical reference for team development, the professional will also be responsible for the validation and consolidation of process data used throughout the different phases of the project;
  • The role requires strong interaction with multidisciplinary teams and with internal and external clients, ensuring the proper alignment of assumptions, requirements, and discipline deliverables;
  • Previous proven experience in mining projects is required, particularly in Study phases, Conceptual Engineering, Basic Engineering, and/or Detailed Engineering , including active participation in the development of mass balances, PFDs, P&IDs, control philosophies, operation manuals, technical specifications, and technical reports , among other documents that are part of the Process discipline scope.
About you
  • Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Chemical Engineering , with more than 10 years of professional experience;

title: Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4)
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Safety & Security

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions
Your Profile Education
  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field
Experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Engenheira(o) de HSE
description:
Resumo da Posição

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de HSE será responsável por planejar, coordenar e executar os programas e processos de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) em todas as operações e projetos da GreenYellow Brasil, atuando nas frentes de sistemas fotovoltaicos (C&I), eficiência energética e armazenamento de energia (BESS).

Será a referência técnica em HSE, orientando uma equipe composta por dois Técnicos de HSE e empresas contratadas, garantindo a conformidade legal, técnica e corporativa, além de promover uma cultura sólida de prevenção, bem‑estar e sustentabilidade.

Além das responsabilidades operacionais de HSE, o(a) profissional terá papel estratégico nas iniciativas ESG, contribuindo para as metas ambientais, sociais e de governança da GreenYellow e assegurando a integração dos princípios de sustentabilidade e responsabilidade corporativa às operações e projetos da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades Segurança do Trabalho (Safety)
  • Coordenar e supervisionar os programas de segurança em todas as fases dos projetos – engenharia, construção, operação e manutenção.
  • Elaborar e implementar planos de resposta a emergências, planos de evacuação e simulados de crise, garantindo a prontidão das brigadas e dos recursos de segurança.
  • Conduzir investigações de incidentes e acidentes, identificando causas‑raiz e assegurando a implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas eficazes.
  • Planejar e realizar inspeções e auditorias de campo, junto aos Técnicos de Segurança, assegurando o cumprimento das NRs aplicáveis (NR10, NR18, NR33, NR35, entre outras).
  • Garantir a conformidade com legislações e normas técnicas de segurança no setor de energia renovável, sistemas elétricos e ambientes industriais/comerciais, incluindo projetos com armazenamento de energia.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Engenharia, Construção, Operação e Manutenção na análise de riscos, controle documental e avaliação de contratadas sob aspectos de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e manter programas de segurança, incluindo o Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos (PGR).
Saúde Ocupacional (Health)
  • Apoiar a elaboração e execução do Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional (PCMSO), em parceria com o médico do trabalho.
  • Monitorar e incentivar campanhas de vacinação, ergonomia, exames periódicos e programas de promoção à saúde e bem‑estar.
  • Avaliar e controlar riscos ocupacionais (ruído, calor, agentes químicos, ergonômicos etc.), propondo e implementando medidas de mitigação.
  • Implementar e comunicar ações de conscientização sobre saúde mental, ergonomia e qualidade de vida no trabalho, alinhadas às políticas corporativas.
  • Participar de comitês de saúde e qualidade de vida, integrando indicadores de saúde ocupacional às metas corporativas de HSE.
ESG (Environmental, Social & Governance)
  • Atuar de forma integrada às metas ESG da GreenYellow, apoiando o monitoramento e reporte de indicadores de sustentabilidade (carbono evitado, reciclagem, eficiência energética, diversidade e segurança).
  • Fornecer dados e análises técnicas para os relatórios anuais e/ou de sustentabilidade da empresa.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Marketing e Responsabilidade Social Corporativa (CSR) na divulgação de resultados e boas práticas em ESG.
  • Apoiar a implementação de políticas e programas socioambientais, contribuindo para metas de neutralidade de carbono e segurança total.
  • Participar ativamente de auditorias e certificações ESG e de segurança (ex.: ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
Relacionamento com Stakeholders
  • Liderar tecnicamente a equipe de HSE, garantido padronização de processos, eficiência na execução de inspeções e gestão adequada de EPIs e registros legais.
  • Promover o desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental da equipe, estimulando autonomia, disciplina e melhoria contínua.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.
Core Competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or related field (required)
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working in higher‑education operations.
  • Workday HR and Workday Finance familiarity.
  • Experience working with academic departments.
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Proficiency in Workday HR required.
  • Proficiency in Workday Finance preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and shared workflow systems.
  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.

$20,000-$30,000

description:
A Cedro Mineração é uma empresa especializada na extração, beneficiamento e comercialização do minério de ferro, matéria-prima que sustenta a produção de diversos setores da economia nacional e mundial. Nossa atuação é pautada por investimentos significativos em tecnologia, pesquisa e desenvolvimento de produção sustentável com grande respeito ao meio ambiente para consolidar a empresa como referência do setor mineral brasileiro.

Fundada em 2018, a Cedro é, para todos os envolvidos, uma empresa cidadã cujo desenvolvimento integra a preocupação com seus colaboradores, o olhar atento para a comunidade, uma atuação ambientalmente sustentável provendo o melhor produto a nossos clientes.

Em 2018, iniciamos nossas operações na Mina do Gama, que já estava em funcionamento desde a década de 90, no município de Nova Lima. Em 2020, a Cedro Mineração adquiriu a Extrativa Mineral, antiga responsável pela operação da Mina do Gama, tornando-se assim a nova responsável pela operação.

Com o compromisso de estarmos na vanguarda da mineração, em 2020 tivemos a antiga barragem de rejeito da Mina do Gama descaracterizada pela ANM. Investimos no processo de filtragem de 100% do rejeito gerado com posterior empilhamento a seco. Além disso, promovemos o reaproveitamento de aproximadamente 85% da água utilizada no processo de produção, intensificamos a gestão ambiental, a saúde e a segurança das operações, e também investimos em várias ações sociais. Posteriormente, em 2022, iniciamos uma nova operação na cidade de Mariana.

Nossa atuação gerou, até este momento, mais de 1.000 empregos diretos, somados a outros 1.500 indiretos como, transportadores do nosso produto e prestadores de serviços focados na valorização pessoal e profissional, na saúde e segurança. Investimos constantemente na capacitação do nosso time de colaboradores, que atuam nas operações de Nova Lima e Mariana.

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos.   • Track record of executive engagement and influence with C-level leadership at Fortune 1000 companies.
  • Hands‑on knowledge of AI/ML technologies, including predictive modeling, LLMs, automation, and ethical AI practices in enterprise settings.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, integration patterns, and multi-org / hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Passion for community-building—mentoring architects, hosting forums, and codifying best practices.
  • Exceptional communication skills and executive presence; able to lead architectural conversations at both strategic and technical levels.
  • Experience with Agentforce and Agent Builder, including designing, deploying, and governing autonomous agents in enterprise environments.
  • Deep industry vertical fluency in one or more sectors (e.g., Financial Services, Retail, Manufacturing, Healthcare) to contextualize architecture recommendations for enterprise customers.
  • Hands‑on experience with integration platforms — particularly MuleSoft — and the ability to design robust, scalable data and API strategies across complex enterprise landscapes.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in a consulting, advisory, or CTO/CIO-facing role at a system integrator, platform vendor, or enterprise IT team.

O Projeto de Expansão do Claretiano – Centro Universitário está pautado em seu carisma missionário, que prima por “(...) capacitar a pessoa humana para o exercício profissional e para o compromisso com a vida” e, também, “(...) pelo ensino e difusão da cultura”, tendo, nos seus polos de Educação a Distância, locais de constante manutenção da Missão educativa. Onde houver espaço para a constituição de uma comunidade educativa, haverá espaço para a educação claretiana. A partir dessa premissa, o Claretiano estrutura-se de modo a atender não só aos interesses internos, mas também aos interesses da sociedade, carregando consigo o atento compromisso de responder ao Plano Nacional da Educação (PNE) em suas ambiciosas metas, dentre elas, elevar o número de alunos matriculados na Educação Superior.   • Auxiliar à Coordenadoria Geral de EaD e Gerência de Educação à Distância na prospecção e implantação de novos polos.
  • Prospectar novos convênios para fins de estágio, utilização de laboratórios, áreas de esportes, clínicas, dentre outros locais indispensáveis para formação didática pedagógica.
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir, na esfera de sua competência, as disposições legais relativas à organização e administração dos recursos humanos do polo.
  • Cuidar da conservação, recuperação e manutenção das instalações e demais recursos físicos, equipamentos e materiais do polo.

Nosso modo de fazer no time

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário
  • Gerir um time de executivos comerciais, acompanhando de perto o desempenho individual e coletivo, garantindo o atingimento das metas e KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Participar ativamente de negociações-chave e contas estratégicas, apoiando o time em processos consultivos, complexos e orientados a dados.
  • Direcionar a equipe aplicando a lógica do 80/20, priorizando oportunidades de maior impacto e valor estratégico para o negócio.
  • Entender profundamente as dores e desafios dos clientes (restaurantes, mercados e/ou parceiros) e demonstrar o valor agregado e o diferencial competitivo das soluções do iFood (incluindo iFood Pago/Benefícios).
  • Desenvolver, capacitar e reter o talento da equipe por meio de treinamentos contínuos, feedbacks estruturados e acompanhamento em campo.
  • Estar presente junto a clientes e parceiros estratégicos, construindo e mantendo um relacionamento de longo prazo e alta confiança.
  • Atuar em um mercado competitivo, desenvolvendo e implementando estratégias de diferenciação que vão além da precificação, focando em valor e inovação.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance (vendas, churn, satisfação do cliente, etc.), propondo planos de ação corretivos e de crescimento.
Ingredientes que buscamos
  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de equipes comerciais, de preferência em mercados competitivos, de alto volume e rápido crescimento.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados, com forte habilidade para definir prioridades estratégicas e tomar decisões baseadas em insights extraídos de dados.
  • Capacidade de conduzir e apoiar negociações complexas, agregando valor além do preço.
  • Domínio em Gestão de Funil de Vendas e ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Habilidade de analisar relatórios de BI/Dados (ex: Power BI, Tableau) e conhecimento básico em SQL para consultas.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Forte habilidade para construir confiança, negociar em diferentes níveis e manter relacionamentos positivos e duradouros com parceiros e clientes.
  • Adaptabilidade e Resiliência: Capacidade de lidar com o ritmo acelerado e as mudanças constantes de um ambiente de tecnologia e scale-up.
  • Energia positiva, Criatividade e Orientação para Resultados: Drive para inovar, buscar soluções e entregar resultados ambiciosos.
  • Senso de Dono e Perfil Estratégico/Negociação: Assumir responsabilidade e ter uma visão de longo prazo sobre o impacto das decisões comerciais.
Sobre nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether. Conheça nossas iniciativas – link omitted.

Você tem fome de que?

Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando “fora da caixa” e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade! Temos fome de diversidade, conhecimento e compartilhamento. Trabalhamos em um ambiente de muita versatilidade. Sabe o que promove a nossa receita especial? As pessoas! Vem fazer parte disso
